adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is initialized as `eventType.destinationCalendar ? [..] : organizerUser.destinationCalendar ? [..] : null`. Immediately after, for COLLECTIVE team events the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If both the event type and organizer lack a destination calendar, `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, so the optional-chained `push` is a no-op and any collected `teamDestinationCalendars` (built from `users.slice(1)` when they have `user.destinationCalendar`) are silently dropped.
